messages:
maria_cs: FYI @devin_re @sam_run — LumenPay onboarding: checkout NLU median latency ~2.1s, spikes to 3.4s under load. They flagged user drop on mobile. Sharing recent trace + small dataset.

maria_cs: link: https://redwood.internal/traces/lumenpay/190876/summary :point_up:

maria_cs: thinking we should propose a short runway: quantized candidate + smarter routing fallback, keep quality checks. Thoughts?

devin_re: saw the trace, thanks. main hotspot is kv-cache misses and long first-token time. model is rwd-gpt-7b (fp16).
devin_re: quick idea: try int8 dynamic quant for inference path and add prefix caching for user session tokens. should drop median by ~25-35% in env tests.

sam_run: agree. also consider routing short requests to smaller model (rwd-gpt-3.5-code) with confidence routing. If confidence low, failover to 7b. Keeps cost down.

oliver_se: +1. We can gate with canary 5% for a day, monitor errors/regressions. Need a short playbook for customer enablement and rollback triggers.

maria_cs: draft playbook points: 1) create canary route 5% -> quantized 7b-int8; 2) set short-term fallback to rwd-gpt-3.5 for <128 tokens; 3) monitor latency, 95p error, and complaint tags; 4) daily sync for 72h.

infra-bot: deploy-check: available capacity for canary on west-us-2: 12 GPUs idle. Recommended batch size 4 for stable latency.

devin_re: sample CLI to spin canary (put in ticket):
```bash
redwoodctl routes create --account lumenpay --name lp-latency-canary \
  --policy "canary=5,region=west-us-2,model=rwd-gpt-7b-int8" \
  --fallback "rwd-gpt-3.5" --batch-size 4
```

sam_run: add evals step before canary: run ~500 recent prompts through rwd-gpt-7b-int8 and compare embed+generation ROUGE/QA metrics. If quality delta > 2% on key prompts, hold.

oliver_se: i'll own the metric dashboard and rollback hooks. propose thresholds: latency reduction >=20% and quality delta <=1.5%. rollback if error rate increases >0.5pp.

maria_cs: i'll send customer note that we plan a low-risk canary and will coordinate a 2-hour window for initial rollout. Also ask them for any critical prompts to add to eval set.

deploy-bot: route lp-latency-canary created in staging. Can deploy to prod after sign-off. :white_check_mark:

devin_re: extra ops tip: enable KV prefix caching for session keys: config snippet below — this reduces first-token by avoiding cold KV lookups.

```yaml
model_cache:
  enabled: true
  prefix_window: 64
  eviction_policy: lru
  reserved_memory_mb: 512
```

maria_cs: thanks all — i'll compile these into the customer playbook and open a ticket with steps + timeline. tagging @oliver_se for dashboard alerts and @devin_re for rollout ops.

sam_run: I'll prepare the eval harness and run overnight tests. Expect initial numbers by tomorrow morning.

maria_cs: perfect. cc @lumenpay-success-team — we'll follow up with the exact 2-hour maintenance window options. :handshake:

oliver_se: added grafana panels and slack alert on >0.5pp error delta.

maria_cs: closing the thread for now, will update when canary is live.
